speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat
text: asked the Minister for Foreign Affairs in light of the volatile situation in Hong Kong (a) what is the Ministry's advice to Singaporeans who are working on the island; and (b) how many Singaporeans in Hong Kong are currently registered with the Ministry.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We keep in close touch with the Singaporean community there through the Singapore Consulate-General.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Singaporeans in Hong Kong who require consular assistance should get in touch with us.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We continue to urge Singaporeans to e-register with us whenever they travel.

speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
text: One is, have there been any instances so far of Singaporeans being affected in the separate incidents over the past month or so?

speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
text: The second question is, so far, among those registered with the Ministry in Hong Kong, do they include students on scholarships there and in other educational institutions there as well?
